name: Break-even ROAS and CPA calculator
why: Works out the most you can pay per sale from price and margin, the number every Snapchat test is judged against.

name: Platform ROAS reality check
why: Compares Snapchat's reported return, on its 28-day window, with your shop totals before you scale.

name: Conversion tracking fixer
why: Plans the repair when sales from ads are missing or doubled, to pair with the kit's Pixel and Conversions API check.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: A monthly check that catches broken Pixel or server events and double counts after a site or checkout change.

name: Monthly catalogue clean-up keeper
why: Finds product data gaps each month so Dynamic Ads keep running on a clean catalog.

name: Shopping feed title writer
why: Rewrites product titles in the feed so Dynamic Ads show clear, specific names.

name: Ad test budget calculator
why: Sets daily spend and how much to spend before judging a creative test, allowing for late conversions.

name: Creative test reader
why: Reads test results by ad and flags false winners before budget moves.

name: Ad fatigue watcher
why: Catches tired ads early so fresh concepts are briefed in time.

name: Short video hook writer
why: Opening lines for full-screen vertical video, where the first two seconds decide the swipe.

name: Five-part creator ad script writer
why: Turns a creator brief into a timed script from hook to call to action.

name: Creator pay planner
why: Works out a fair fee for a creator post, for the client to approve and pay.

name: Retargeting ad sequence planner
why: Plans what viewers and cart adders see next, to sit alongside Dynamic Ads.

name: India data privacy checker
why: Checks consent and data handling against India's rules before a customer list or server events go to Snap.
